_comment: X API v2 search queries used to build the dataset. Each entry is run against /2/tweets/search/all (full archive) or /2/tweets/search/recent (--recent). start_time defaults to the GPT Image 2.5 launch (2026-09-08).

queries.name: q02_prompt
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5 OR gptimage25 OR "gptimage 2.5") prompt has:images -is:retweet

queries.name: q04_prompt_recent
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5 OR gptimage25 OR "gptimage 2.5") prompt has:images -is:retweet

queries.name: q03_multilang
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5) (提示词 OR プロンプト OR "prompt:" OR "Prompt 👇" OR "prompt below" OR "prompt in alt") has:images -is:retweet

queries.name: q05_inline
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5) ("prompt:" OR "提示词：") has:images -is:retweet -is:reply

queries.name: q06_zh
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5) (提示词 OR prompt OR 咒语) lang:zh has:images -is:retweet

queries.name: q07_ja
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5) (プロンプト OR prompt) lang:ja has:images -is:retweet

queries.name: q09_inline_or_below
queries.query: ("gpt image 2.5" OR "gpt-image-2.5" OR gptimage2.5) ("prompt:" OR "prompt below" OR "Prompt 👇" OR 提示词) has:images -is:retweet -is:reply

queries.name: q10_name_variants
queries.query: (gptimage25 OR "gptimage 2.5" OR "chatgpt images 2.5" OR "gpt image2.5") has:images -is:retweet

self_reply_query: ((from:{user} (conversation_id:{id} OR ...)) OR ...) is:reply -has:mentions   — grouped, kept under ~1000 characters, for posts whose prompt is in the author's own replies

video._comment: Seedance 2.5 AI-video prompt posts (videos.html). Run with: python3 scripts/fetch_x.py --video. Raw files are saved as raw/<date>_video_*.txt; only files whose name contains '_video_' feed the video page. Posts tagged with other Seedance versions would be shown under a separate '其他 Seedance' filter, never as 2.5.

queries.name: video_v02_prompt
queries.query: ("seedance 2.5" OR seedance2.5 OR "seedance-2.5") (prompt OR 提示词 OR プロンプト OR 咒语) has:videos -is:retweet

queries.name: video_v03_prompt_windows
queries.query: ("seedance 2.5" OR seedance2.5 OR "seedance-2.5") (prompt OR 提示词 OR プロンプト OR 咒语) has:videos -is:retweet

queries.name: video_v04_platforms
queries.query: (即梦 OR jimeng OR dreamina OR 豆包 OR capcut) ("seedance 2.5" OR seedance2.5 OR "seedance-2.5" OR "seedance 2.5 pro") has:videos -is:retweet

queries.name: video_v05_prompt_recent_windows
queries.query: ("seedance 2.5" OR seedance2.5 OR "seedance-2.5") (prompt OR 提示词 OR プロンプト OR 咒语) has:videos -is:retweet

video.self_reply_query: (from:<author> (conversation_id:<id> OR ...)) is:reply -has:mentions — run for video posts whose text points to the prompt in replies; the author's own replies are hydrated with GET /2/tweets?ids=...
